name: Natsumatsuri
source:
In summer main character decides to return to his native town. A nostalgic view, a comfortable air, a faint sound of river calm his mind. At the summer festival he meets his old acquaintance, and their memories start to shine anew. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
夏天，主角决定回到故乡。怀旧的风景、舒适的空气、隐约可闻的流水声让他平静下来。在夏日祭典上他遇到了旧相识，他们的记忆开始重新闪耀。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
